title: Workflow definition
description: A governed SDLC workflow graph. Validated at load, before any node runs: a malformed definition must fail loudly when it is introduced, not silently in the middle of a run where a stalled scheduler and a broken graph look identical.

name.description: Definition name. Runs reference it by this.

version.description: Incremented by replanning. Stamped on every journal and audit row so a later version can never silently reinterpret an earlier run.

agentType.description: Must resolve to a registered agent. An unregistered type is what keeps a definition file from becoming a way to run arbitrary code.

dependsOn.description: The node's entry gate. Every id must exist, and the graph must stay acyclic.

requiresApproval.description: Marks a human gate. Such a node is never dispatched to an agent.

branchCondition.description: SpEL over #input and #facts, evaluated read-only. A false condition skips the node with its reason recorded.

maxAttempts.description: Total attempts including the first. Retry is engine-owned; agents must not retry internally.

recoveryMode.description: Declared, never inferred. Calling something rollbackable when a side effect was already observed is what makes an audit trail lie.

fallbackAllowed.description: Whether a permanent failure may be absorbed as a degraded success, which downgrades the run outcome.

supersedes.description: For a gate: the upstream node whose artifact this decision replaces. Setting it turns an approval into a replanning trigger.

producesArtifacts.description: The node's exit gate. An agent that reports success without producing these has failed, not succeeded.
